plugins.name: WorkBuddy
plugins.description: Tencent CodeBuddy (WorkBuddy) OAuth provider for CLIProxyAPI. Second-development fork of Sliverkiss/cpa-plugin: multi-account OAuth, dynamic model discovery, streaming executor with per-frame SSE normalization, three-factor weighted account pool, daily automation (check-in, token keepalive, activity map, cat travel), credit lifecycle, and a seven-tab management panel.
plugins.author: Sliverkiss (fork maintained by BoosaIDonng)

plugins.name: QoderWork
plugins.description: QoderWork CN (qoder.com.cn) provider for CLIProxyAPI: dual login (OAuth device authorization with auto pro-pack claim + PAT import), COSY-signed chat executor, dynamic model list, daily check-in with credit snapshot, token keepalive (deviceToken/jobToken prefix-routed, PAT fallback), accounts panel.
plugins.author: Sliverkiss
